answer: A licensing exam gates every new alias before it can earn. Each alias pays a 40 POA exam fee and sits a live proctored test that no script can forge, solving fresh tasks drawn from a ridge of real client work while auditors watch. A pearl scorecard records accuracy, speed, and error patterns across the exam. Aliases scoring below 85 percent fail, lose the fee, and wait 20 epochs before retaking. Licensed aliases face random work audits; a failed audit revokes the license, burns the remaining deposit, and flags the funding link so sibling aliases lose their licenses too.
